title: Preparation of 5M Guanidine thiocyanate L6 Inactivation Buffer
author: Nicola O'Reilly
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfevjje6
materials: Please select between the recipes for 1 L, 2 L, 4.3 L and 5.4 L L6 5 M Guanidine thiocyanate Inactivation buffer . Upon contact with acids, GuSCN can produce a toxic gas (HCN). As a precaution, GuSCN-containing buffers are prepared in a fume hood.
After the aliquoting is complete, change gloves.

steps.title: Prepare 1 L Batch of L6 Inactivation Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1 L volume of 5M Guanidine thiocyanate L6 Inactivation Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Weigh out 600 g GuSCN and add to a 1 L beaker.
Measure out 500 mL 0.1 M Tris HCl and add to the beaker.
Measure out 110 mL 0.2 M EDTA, pH 8.0 and add to the beaker; stir and heat to 60 °C if required.
Once GuSCN is dissolved, add 13 mL Triton X-100 to the beaker and stir well.
Label with batch and date.
Store in the dark at room temperature (15 °C – 25 °C).

steps.title: Prepare 2 L Batch of L6 Inactivation Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare a 2 L volume of 5M Guanidine thiocyanate L6 Inactivation Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Weigh out 1200 g GuSCN and add to a 2 L beaker.
Measure out 1000 mL 0.1 M Tris HCl and add to the beaker.
Measure out 220 mL 0.2 M EDTA, pH 8.0 and add to the beaker; heat to 60 °C if required.
Once GuSCN is dissolved, add 26 mL Triton X-100 to the beaker and stir well.
Label with batch and date.
Store in the dark at room temperature (15 °C – 25 °C).

steps.title: Prepare Intermediate Batch (approx 3 L)
steps.instruction: Prepare a larger volume of buffer using a 5 L beaker.

substeps.instruction: Weigh out 2.4 kg GuSCN in aliquots using a 3 L beaker and carefully add to a 5 L beaker while stirring and heating to 60 °C.
Rinse the 3 L beaker with 0.4 L 0.1 M Tris HCl and add to the 5 L beaker.
Stir manually with a sterile 10 ml pipette if required.
Measure out 1.6 L 0.1 M Tris HCl and add to the 5 L beaker.
Measure out 440 mL 0.2 M EDTA, pH 8.0 and add to the beaker.
Label with batch and date.
Store in the dark at room temperature (15 °C – 25 °C).

steps.title: Prepare Large Batch (approx 4 L)
steps.instruction: Prepare the largest volume of buffer using a 5 L beaker and bottle.

substeps.instruction: Measure out 2.0 L 0.1 M Tris HCl and add to a 5 L beaker.
Weigh out 3 kg GuSCN in aliquots using a 3 L beaker and carefully add to the 5 L beaker while stirring and heating to 60 °C.
Rinse the 3 L beaker with 0.5 L 0.1 M Tris HCl and add to the 5 L beaker.
Stir manually with a sterile 10 ml pipette if required.
Measure out 550 mL 0.2 M EDTA, pH 8.0 and add to a bottle.
Add 65 mL Triton X-100 to the bottle and swirl well to mix.
Once GuSCN is dissolved, add 52 mL Triton X-100 to the beaker and stir well to mix.
Once GuSCN is dissolved, transfer to a 5 L single use tissue culture bottle.
Label with batch and date.
Store in the dark at room temperature (15 °C – 25 °C).

steps.title: Aliquot Buffer into Tubes
steps.instruction: Aliquot the 5 M guanidine thiocyanate into smaller tubes within a tissue culture hood.

substeps.instruction: Within a tissue culture hood cupboard, aliquot 1 mL 5 M guanidine thiocyanate into 2 ml tubes and replace lids.
Label with batch and date.
Place tubes in a box clearly marked '5 M guanidine thiocyanate L6 Lysis buffer'.
Store in the dark at room temperature.
Clean the hood, dispose of waste, and switch off the tissue culture hood.
